text: Lightning protection shall follow IEC 62305 (all parts) with a risk assessment (IEC 62305-2) for every structure, based on the Owner data of ER-02.12: 26 thunderstorm days per year and a ground flash density of DP-OWNR-0009. The risk assessment (ALP-EPC-00000-EL-STU-0004) sets the lightning protection level (LPL) of each structure.
